Programme

The workshop takes place over two days, 2–3 December 2026, at CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security in Saarbrücken, Germany.

The programme will bring together invited talks, discussions, and a poster session, with time to exchange ideas across the foundations and applications of uncertainty in AI.

Invited talks

Perspectives on the foundations of uncertainty and their role in modern AI.

Discussions

Time to exchange ideas, compare approaches, and explore open questions together.

Poster session

An opportunity to share research and discuss work directly with its authors.
